title: Efficacy and Safety of Endovascular Recanalization for Non-acute Intracranial Arterial Occlusion: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
design: 系统综述与Meta分析（23项研究）
population: 非急性颅内动脉闭塞（前+后循环）
complications: 围手术期并发症 13% (10–15)；围手术期死亡 0%
outcome: 长期卒中复发/死亡 7% (4–9)；再通成功 vs 失败 OR 0.15 (0.06–0.37)
conclusion: 非急性颅内动脉闭塞再通总体安全有效；前后循环再通率与并发症无显著差异，但异质性高、对照极少。
authors_full: Chen Xiuen, Zhou Ting, Xiao Chao, Lan Yining, Chen Dandan, Lu Jing et al.

title: Endovascular treatment for non-acute intracranial vertebrobasilar artery occlusion in Chinese elderly: Efficacy and safety outcomes.
design: 单中心回顾性队列（EVT vs 保守）
population: 中国老年非急性颅内VBA闭塞
conclusion: 老年NAIVBAO中EVT可能降低1年卒中复发/死亡并改善功能结局；单中心回顾性，需RCT验证。
authors_full: Li Weili, Zhang Jun, Zhu Chenlu, Meng Yao, Yin Hao, Sun Lili et al.

title: Endovascular Recanalization of Non-Acute Vertebrobasilar Occlusion in Progressive Posterior Circulation Ischemia: A Case Report.
population: 非急性椎基底动脉闭塞（左侧V4，右侧VA发育不良）
conclusion: 选择性非急性VBO再通技术可行；单例不能证明优于药物治疗或长期耐久。
authors_full: Soetanto Gamaliel Wibowo, Wiyarta Elvan

title: Endovascular Revascularization for Chronic Vertebral Artery Occlusion with Poor Collateral Circulation and a Large Perfusion Abnormality Identified by Automated Perfusion Imaging: A Case Report.
population: 症状性ICVA慢性完全闭塞（双侧VA闭塞）
complications: 术后小脑梗死，无新发神经功能缺损
conclusion: 自动灌注成像（RAPID）发现低灌注区，可辅助筛选慢性ICVA CTO再通候选者。
authors_full: Yamada Daisuke, Akiyama Yoshinori, Akiyama Ryo, Matsukawa Hidetoshi, Shimizu Fuminori, Sakai Nobuyuki

title: Endovascular recanalization of symptomatic long-segment nonacute vertebral artery occlusion: a case report.
population: 症状性长节段非急性左VA闭塞（V1–V4）
outcome: 术后无新发症状；2年随访通畅
conclusion: 经仔细评估后，长节段非急性VA闭塞再通可行。
authors_full: Jian Yuan, Xiaobo Dong, Wenxin Wang, Gesheng Wang

title: Distal protection of endovascular recanalization for symptomatic non-acute occlusion of vertebrobasilar artery.
population: 症状性非急性VBA闭塞
outcome: 90 d mRS 0–2 75%；1例非手术相关死亡
conclusion: 支架取栓器作远端保护可能减少再通过程中的远端栓塞，需更大样本验证。
authors_full: Li Qiuli, Yao Xiaoxi, Lei Yuanbiao, Li Haipeng, Tu Liu, Zhang Yi

title: Predictors of successful recanalization following endovascular intervention in non-acute basilar artery occlusion.
design: 单中心回顾性+预测评分
population: 非急性基底动脉闭塞（NABAO）
conclusion: 闭塞>3个月、钝头残端、闭塞长度>30 mm、远端代偿不足是再通失败的独立负向预测因素。
authors_full: Liu Ying, Wu Zuoli, Wei Shengwei, He Wenbo, Ye Weihao, Xu Shang et al.

title: Outcomes of Endovascular Treatment in Patients With Vertebrobasilar Artery Occlusion Beyond 24 Hours.
population: VBO>24h
conclusion: 超过24h的VBO，EVT+BMT可能改善功能结局并降低死亡；属急性/亚急性范畴，非慢性闭塞。
authors_full: Liu Shuai, Xu Yongbo, Nguyen Thanh N, Gao Feng, Xue Yuanyuan, Liu Shuling et al.

title: Endovascular therapy for acute vertebrobasilar occlusion (VERITAS): a systematic review and individual patient data meta-analysis.
design: 系统综述+个体数据Meta分析（4项RCT）
population: 急性VBO（发病≤12h为主）
conclusion: 急性VBO血管内治疗显著改善90 d功能结局；这是慢性/非急性决策的背景证据，不能直接外推。
authors_full: Nogueira Raul G, Jovin Tudor G, Liu Xinfeng, Hu Wei, Langezaal Lucianne C M, Li Chuanhui et al.

title: Retrograde recanalization for vertebral artery occlusion without a stump (REVANS): a technical note.
population: 无残端的VA闭塞
conclusion: REVANS技术利用颈部侧支逆行进入闭塞段，为无残端VAO提供再通入路。
authors_full: Wang Jian, Jiang Xin, Zheng Hongbo, He Li, Hu Fayun

title: Endovascular recanalization of symptomatic chronic cerebral artery occlusion: predictors for successful recanalization and perioperative complications.
design: 单中心回顾性+预测模型
population: 症状性慢性颅内大动脉闭塞（含VBA）
conclusion: 残端形态、距末次神经事件时间、年龄、吸烟、NLR可预测慢性闭塞再通成败。
authors_full: Zhang Xueqian, Li Yang, Yin Kuochang, Hao Zhiwei, Fu Yidian, Yang Qishuo et al.

title: Radiological features on high-resolution MR imaging predicts successful recanalization in patients with symptomatic chronic intracranial large artery occlusion.
design: 单中心回顾性+预测评分
population: 症状性慢性颅内大动脉闭塞（含VBA）
conclusion: HR-MRI示残留管腔、明显斑块强化、闭塞长度≤10.2 mm提示再通成功；VBA较MCA再通率低。
authors_full: Zhou Chun, Cao Yue-Zhou, Jia Zhen-Yu, Zhao Lin-Bo, Lu Shan-Shan, Xu Xiao-Quan et al.

title: Recanalization of atherosclerotic stenosis and occlusion of intracranial vertebrobasilar artery.
population: 颅内椎基底动脉粥样硬化狭窄/非急性闭塞
conclusion: 对药物难治的严重ICVB狭窄/非急性闭塞，个体化PTAS可能可行；支架选择、亚满意扩张与并发症防治是关键。
authors_full: Zhou Zhi-Long, Zhu Liang-Fu, Li Tian-Xiao, Gao Bu-Lang

title: Effects and safety of endovascular recanalization for non-acute symptomatic intracranial vertebral artery occlusion with different risks.
design: 单中心回顾性+风险分层
population: 非急性症状性ICVA闭塞
conclusion: 按闭塞长度、时间、性质、钙化、成角分层可识别再通获益人群；高危组应谨慎。
authors_full: Chen Shunqiang, Xia Jinchao, Xiao Shuxin, Li Tianxiao, Wang Ziliang

title: The morphology of occlusion stump for endovascular recanalization in non-acute vertebral ostial occlusion.
population: 非急性椎动脉开口闭塞（VOO）
outcome: 锥形残端再通90.9% vs 非锥形40%
conclusion: 残端形态（锥形/非锥形）可预测VOO再通成功率，并指导入路选择。
authors_full: Liu Longlong, Wu Jianming, Li Ailing, Teng Jingqian, Jin Yuwen, Ma Binwu

title: Exploring vertebral artery stump syndrome: An overlooked cause of posterior ischemic strokes. A narrative review of current management options.
population: 椎动脉残端综合征（VASS），72例文献汇总
outcome: 抗凝组1例复发；抗血小板4例均复发；慢性期再通可作为选择
conclusion: VASS是后循环栓塞的易漏诊病因；抗凝可能优于抗血小板，慢性期VA再通可用于药物失败者。
authors_full: Rossi Sergio Soeren, Iaccarino Gianmarco, Bonura Adriano, Calandrelli Rosalinda, Spinelli Francesco, Montelione Nunzio et al.

title: Chronic basilar artery occlusion: a retrospective monocentric study.
design: 单中心回顾性（自然病程）
population: 慢性基底动脉闭塞
outcome: 5例偶然发现、4例轻症、6例急性期后存活；均见后交通动脉侧支
conclusion: 慢性BAO可无症状或仅轻症，长期存活；侧支代偿好，提示单中心再通队列存在选择偏倚。
authors_full: Roth Christian, Yavuz Rosa, Maschita Carolin, Ferbert Andreas, Matthaei Johannes

title: Effects of endovascular recanalization on symptomatic non-acute occlusion of intracranial arteries.
design: 单中心回顾性（前+后循环）
population: 症状性非急性颅内大动脉闭塞；VBA亚组58例
outcome: 总体90 d mRS 0–2 94.9%（基线轻症为主）；VBA再狭窄/再闭塞8/48 (16.7%)
conclusion: VBA再通成功率与前循环相近、并发症更低；闭塞长度、钙化、成角是再通失败的独立因素。
authors_full: Xia Jinchao, Gao Huili, Zhang Kun, Gao Bulang, Li Tianxiao, Wang Ziliang

title: Endovascular recanalization of symptomatic non-acute occlusion of the vertebrobasilar artery.
population: 症状性非急性VBA闭塞（SNOVA）
conclusion: 选择性SNOVA再通成功率高、预后改善，但并发症与再狭窄不低；钝头残端、再通时机、后扩张是重要风险因素。
authors_full: Zhou ZhiLong, Li TianXiao, Zhu LiangFu, Wu LiHeng, Guan Min, Ma ZhenKai et al.

title: A novel angiographic classification for the endovascular recanalization of symptomatic nonacute extracranial vertebral artery occlusion.
design: 多中心回顾性+造影分型
population: 症状性非急性颅外VA闭塞（EVAO）
outcome: A型再通100%、并发症0%；D型再通63.6%、并发症27.3%
conclusion: EVAO造影分型（A–D）可预测再通与并发症，A型最适合再通。
authors_full: Gao Feng, Zheng Hongbo, Guo Xu, Sun Xuan, Miao Zhongrong

title: Endovascular recanalization for non-acute basilar artery occlusions with progressive or recurrent ischemic symptoms: a multicenter clinical experience.

population: 症状性非急性BAO伴进展/复发性缺血
conclusion: 短段闭塞且远端BA代偿好（I型）最适合再通；长段/代偿差者风险高。
authors_full: Gao Feng, Han Ju, Guo Xu, Sun Xuan, Ma Ning, Miao Zhongrong

title: Posterior Circulation Ischaemic Stroke.
population: 后循环缺血性卒中

authors_full: Ng Alexander Clevewood

title: Endovascular revascularization of chronically occluded vertebral artery: single-center experience.
population: 慢性VA起始部闭塞

authors_full: Cai Xueli, Huang Liangtong, Chen Xueping, Sun Jingping, Gao Feng

title: Staged Endovascular Treatment for Symptomatic Occlusion Originating From the Intracranial Vertebral Arteries in the Early Non-acute Stage.
design: 单中心回顾性（分期再通）
population: 早期非急性症状性ICVA闭塞
conclusion: 分期再通（先球囊维持灌注、后支架）可用于早期非急性ICVA闭塞的高危患者。
authors_full: Duan Hongzhou, Chen Li, Shen Shengli, Zhang Yang, Li Chunwei, Yi Zhiqiang et al.

title: Endovascular Revascularization of Nonacute Symptomatic Proximal Extracranial Vertebral Artery Occlusion.
population: 非急性症状性近端颅外VA闭塞（PEVAO）
conclusion: 近端颅外VAO再通成功率高、并发症低；需更长期随访。
authors_full: Chen Lizhang, Jiang Yi, Hu Fayun, He Li, Zheng Hongbo

title: Endovascular Recanalization for Nonacute Intracranial Vertebral Artery Occlusion According to a New Classification.
design: 单中心回顾性+新造影分型
population: 症状性非急性ICVA闭塞
conclusion: ICVA闭塞造影分型可预测再通与并发症；I/II型适合再通。
authors_full: Gao Feng, Sun Xuan, Zhang Huijun, Ma Ning, Mo Dapeng, Miao Zhongrong

title: Endovascular Recanalization for Chronic Total Occlusion of Intracranial Vertebral Artery: A Mini Review.
population: ICVA慢性完全闭塞
conclusion: 综述ICVA CTO的定义、发病率、临床表现、血管内再通、并发症与结局。
authors_full: Zhang Ying-Ying

title: Symptomatic Atherosclerotic Non-acute Intracranial Vertebral Artery Total Occlusion: Clinical Features, Imaging Characteristics, Endovascular Recanalization, and Follow-up Outcomes.
population: 症状性动脉粥样硬化性非急性ICVA完全闭塞
conclusion: 低灌注型优势ICVA完全闭塞（长病变、高血栓负荷）再通可行，多数获得良好功能结局。
authors_full: Zhao Wei, Zhang Jun, Meng Yao, Zhang Yuyan, Zhang Jinping, Song Yun et al.

title: Endovascular Recanalization of Nonacute Symptomatic Vertebral Ostial Occlusion Performed Using a Distal Embolic Protection Device.
population: 非急性症状性VA开口闭塞
complications: 无重大急性血栓栓塞事件
conclusion: 远端栓塞保护装置辅助VA开口闭塞支架置入可行，可能减少远端栓塞。
authors_full: Zheng Meimei, Zhang Jinping, Song Yun, Zhao Wei, Sun Lili, Zhang Jun et al.

title: [Expert consensus: endovascular treatment in non-acute occlusion of intracranial and extracranial large vessel in China].
population: 中国非急性颅内/外大血管闭塞
conclusion: 中国非急性颅内/外大血管闭塞血管内治疗专家共识，强调患者选择、影像评估与围术期管理。

title: Endovascular Recanalization for Symptomatic Subacute to Chronic Atherosclerotic Basilar Artery Occlusion.
population: 症状性亚急性–慢性动脉粥样硬化性BAO
conclusion: 药物治疗无效的亚急性–慢性BAO再通在 selected patients 中可行，90 d功能结局较好。
authors_full: Zhao Wei, Zhang Jinping, Song Yun, Sun Lili, Zheng Meimei, Yin Hao et al.

title: Endovascular recanalization for chronic symptomatic intracranial vertebral artery total occlusion: Experience of a single center and review of literature.

authors_full: Gao Peng, Wang Yabing, Ma Yan, Yang Qi, Song Haiqing, Chen Yanfei et al.

conclusion: 非急性VBAO再通技术成功率高但围手术期并发症风险高，需规范并发症防治。
authors_full: He Yingkun, Bai Weixing, Li Tianxiao, Xue Jiangyu, Wang Ziliang, Zhu Liangfu et al.

title: Endovascular recanalization for chronic symptomatic intracranial vertebral artery total occlusion.

authors_full: Xu Ziqi, Ma Ning, Mo Dapeng, Wong Edward Ho Chung, Gao Feng, Jiao Liqun et al.

title: Revascularization with stenting of the nonacute vertebrobasilar artery occlusion.
population: 非急性VBAO支架再通

authors_full: He Yingkun, Wang Ziliang, Li Tianxiao, Zhu Liangfu, Xue Jiangyu, Bai Weixing

authors_full: Lin Ridwan, Aleu Aitziber, Jankowitz Brian, Kostov Dean, Kanaan Hilal, Horowitz Michael et al.

title: Endovascular recanalization of the subacute to chronically occluded basilar artery: initial experience and technical considerations.

population: 亚急性–慢性BAO
conclusion: 慢性BAO再通可行但风险较高，应仅用于药物难治性症状患者，并加强术后管理。
authors_full: Dashti Shervin R, Park Min S, Stiefel Michael F, McDougall Cameron G, Albuquerque Felipe C

title: Intracranial angioplasty and stent placement for direct cerebral revascularization of nonacute intracranial occlusions and near occlusions.
design: 单中心回顾性（前+后循环）
population: 非急性颅内闭塞/近闭塞（1例VA）

title: Endovascular recanalization of basilar artery occlusion 80 days after symptom onset.
population: 症状性BAO 80天

authors_full: Yu Wengui, Kostanian Varoujan, Fisher Mark
